name: fullstack-forge-team
description: Full-stack system delivery team: 8 roles across the full lifecycle for websites, apps, iOS/HarmonyOS apps, mini programs, and software systems — from requirement & platform selection through product, engineering, testing, release, DevOps, and growth

displayDescription.en: An 8-role full-stack delivery team that builds websites, apps, iOS & HarmonyOS apps, mini programs, and software systems end to end — from requirement and platform selection to product, engineering, testing, release, DevOps, and growth.
